name: Lost Deathstalkers
summary: In northern Silverpine, two Forsaken scouts have been missing for weeks. High Executor Hadrec sent Rane and Quinn Yorick to survey haunted farmsteads, and now you must learn what became of them.

sections.title: A Silence from the North
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher has heard nothing from Rane and Quinn Yorick for weeks. He sent the two Deathstalkers into northern Silverpine Forest to watch the abandoned farms and track enemy movements. Deathstalkers are the Forsaken’s hidden scouts and killers, serving Lady Sylvanas. Hadrec fears the Scourge or another threat has cut the scouts down.

sections.title: The Northern Peril
sections.body: Northern Silverpine lies between Lordaeron’s ruined estates and the shadowed borders of Tirisfal Glades. Undead roam there, beasts prowl, and feral worgen make travel perilous even for seasoned rogues. You must search the decaying farmsteads where Rane and Quinn Yorick began their survey, and recover any intelligence they gathered before danger overtook them.

sections.title: Trapped in the Shadows
sections.body: Rane and Quinn Yorick are alive, but trapped at a farm and struggling to stay free. They escaped an attack by the ghoul Ivar the Foul, though Quinn was badly mauled. Ivar lurks nearby, leaving the two Deathstalkers cornered. Their rescue draws the Forsaken into a deeper struggle with the feral threats beyond the road.

faq.q: Who are Rane and Quinn Yorick?
faq.answer: Rane and Quinn Yorick are Forsaken scouts in the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken’s intelligence and assassination wing. They were sent to survey Silverpine Forest’s farmsteads and then disappeared.

faq.q: Why is High Executor Hadrec concerned about them?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec oversees Forsaken military operations from the Sepulcher. With two scouts missing, the Forsaken lack reports on hostile activity along their northern borders, where the Scourge still lingers.

aliases: where to find rane and quinn
faq.answer: The Yoricks disappeared while scouting northern Silverpine Forest. Their route took them through the decaying farmsteads north of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: What threats do the Deathstalkers face in northern Silverpine?
faq.answer: Scourge remnants, aggressive predators, and feral worgen threaten scouts in northern Silverpine. Any of them can kill those who travel alone.

faq.q: What happens after finding the missing Deathstalkers?
faq.answer: Finding Rane Yorick leads to helping the injured scouts recover through Wild Hearts, which brings you against local threats such as Ivar the Foul.

faq.q: Who are the Deathstalkers as an organization?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken’s corps of spies, scouts, and assassins. They serve the Dark Lady as her secretive vanguard across Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know each missing agent could leave a gap in Silverpine’s fragile defenses. Finding your kin helps keep the Sepulcher safe from sudden attack.
As a rogue, you know the Yoricks as fellow operatives of the shadows. Their plight shows that stealth cannot always protect even seasoned Deathstalkers from northern dangers.
As a member of the Horde, you know Silverpine Forest guards a safe corridor between Undercity and southern Lordaeron. Reconnaissance helps protect that route.
